items.title: Akiyoshi Toshiko — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: It was an octet, it was led by an old timer, he‟s a tenor saxophone player, his name was Shin Matsumoto

ctx.x: So, okay, I took a job, I was the piano player with Ichiban Octet. This was the group that was playing in the Shinagawa depot. This was the first, this was predominantly black people. I think maybe it was a sergeants‟ club, I‟m not quite sure.
You said, where was it? Shinagawa?
